title: Crime Scene Documentation and Reconstruction Tools
text: Tools crime scene investigators, built one. core shooting incident reconstruction explicit uncertainty, following standard field workflow (Haag & Haag 2020; Hueske 2015; OSAC 2025-N-0003 terminology): impact angle defect ellipse, Monte Carlo interval; trajectories rod/laser angles, two points, single defect’s ellipse plus directionality; possible origin fire assumed muzzle heights, bounded scene size; segmented paths intermediate targets, measured deflection angles joint-consistency checks, explicitly flagged assumed deflections path object documented; convergence several trajectories (closest approach, miss distance, whether lies behind defects); plan elevation plots showing cone uncertainty, just line. Supporting modules: Scene mapping: baseline, triangulation polar/total-station measurements one XY frame (plus height z), plan view room outline, wall elevation views. Scene objects: furniture, appliances persons schematic boxes placed way measured (wall, corner, two corners), semi-transparent default, drawn every view; trajectories checked objects back-projected path. 3D reconstruction: objects rendered schematic, -scale room numbered floor axes, evidence markers, bullet defects height, trajectory rods uncertainty cones. rayrender still PDF/Word, interactive rgl widget HTML (optional dependencies). Evidence documentation: evidence items, chain custody, photo hashes, structured death scene observation record (observations ; time since death coroner’s determination). Reports render Word, PDF HTML one template, ending one-line note forensicR version produced .

title: forensicR 0.0.1
text: Initial development version. Scene mapping: coords_baseline(), coords_triangulation(), coords_polar(), plot_scene(). Shooting reconstruction uncertainty: impact_angle(), trajectory_from_angles(), trajectory_2pt(), trajectory_from_defect(), origin_zone(), intersect_trajectories(), trajectory_table(), plot_trajectories(). Scene points carry optional height z type (evidence, defect, bloodstain). Wall elevation views: wall_from_room(), plot_wall_elevation(). Room outlines plots: room_rect(), opening(); plan view can overlay convergence cloud trajectories. 3D reconstruction, schematic scale: render_scene_3d() (rayrender still image) scene_3d_widget() (interactive rgl/WebGL widget); optional dependencies. Segmented trajectories intermediate targets: trajectory_path(), path_deflections() (measured deflection Monte Carlo interval joint consistency), assumed_segment() (explicitly flagged assumption). trajectory_2pt() now anchored second point, impact. Scene objects: furniture(), along_wall(), furniture_from_corners(), furniture_catalogue(), furniture_table(), trajectory_obstructions(). Objects schematic, -scale, semi-transparent boxes drawn every view; origin_zone() can exclude positions inside objects. Evidence documentation: evidence_log(), log_item(), log_custody(), file_hash(), death_scene_record(). Four vignettes: getting started (one scene end end), scene mapping, shooting reconstruction, reports 3D. Reports: render_scene_report() renders one template Word, PDF HTML, ending one-line provenance footer.
